summary.text: Annalyse Sarvinas is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 51, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A teacher, she says her campaign centers on lowering costs, education reform, and free-market healthcare.

paragraphs.text: Annalyse Sarvinas earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Southern Maine in 2020.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she earned her degree in English and secondary education and has worked in public and private schools teaching English language arts.

Sarvinas listed three key campaign messages: protecting income and lowering costs by reducing energy costs and tax and regulatory burdens; education reform, including school choice, lower administrative costs, and earlier access to trades and other careers; and free-market healthcare.
She also said she supports literacy initiatives adopted by other states.
